hook_first_words: So, you're Richard Branson in the 1980s

beats: 0-3 s: Hook setup with Branson in the airport.
8-14 s: The solution: chartering a private plane.
14-22 s: The pivot: selling tickets to others.
22-34 s: The epiphany: starting an airline.
34-42 s: The resolution: Virgin Atlantic is born.
visual_techniques: Ken Burns effect (slow zooms/pans) on static images
Graphic overlay: Lightbulb icon appearing over head at 0:29
Halftone/dot-matrix filter applied to archival-style photos at 0:37
captions: Style: Bold, sans-serif font, yellow background, black text. Position: Bottom center. Words per chunk: 3-6 words.
sound: Voice: Deep, authoritative male narrator (AI). Music: Upbeat, rhythmic, synth-driven corporate/documentary track. SFX: Subtle whooshes on transitions.

ending: Punchline: The reveal of the Virgin Atlantic logo and the birth of the company.
why: It uses a 'story-first' approach that turns a business anecdote into a high-stakes adventure. The AI consistency makes it feel like a cohesive, high-budget short film rather than a slideshow, which keeps the viewer engaged through the narrative arc.
reusable_faceless: Using a consistent AI character model to act out historical events
Using simple graphic overlays (like the lightbulb) to signify abstract concepts
Applying texture filters (halftone) to blend AI images with real historical footage
Pacing the story around a 'what if' moment to drive curiosity
